data.contenido:
Omuyengeli Gabriel okwa tumwa a ye komukiintu omugundjuka omwaanawa gwedhina Maria. Ye okwe mu lombwele kutya ota ka mona okanona hoka taka ka pangela sigo aluhe oko omukwaniilwa. Okanona haka Jesus oka valelwa moshigunda moka aasita ye ya oku ka talela po. Konima onyothi yokUuzilo oya kwatele aalumentu komeho okuya kokanona okashona. Tse otatu ilongo kutya olye e ya monitha onyothi ndjoka, nonkene Jesus a hupithwa koonkambadhala ndhoka dhoku mu dhipaga.

Konima otatu mono Jesus sho ye a li e na oomvula 12 ta kundathana naalongihapu motempeli. Konima yoomvula 18 Jesus okwi ininginitha, nopo nduno ota tameke iilonga yUukwaniilwa yeuvitho noyelongo mbyoka Kalunga e mu tumine kombanda yevi oku yi longa. Okwiikwathela miilonga mbika, Jesus okwa hogolola aalumentu 12 nokwe ya ningi aayapostoli ye.

Jesus okwa longo wo iikumithalonga oyindji. Ye okwa palutha wo aantu omayuvi noohi dhontumba niikwiila yimwe po owala. Ye okwa aludha aavu nonokuli okwa yumudha aasi. Lwahugunina otatu ilongo kombinga yiinima oyindji mbyoka ya ningilwa Jesus pomasiku gahugunina gonkalamwenyo ye, nonkene ye a dhipagwa. Jesus oku uvitha uule woomvula ndatu netata lwaampano. OSHITOPOLWA 6 otashi hokolola ano ethimbo olindji kashona li vulithe poomvula 34.

OMUKIINTU nguka omwaanawa oMaria. Ye Omwiisrael ngoka a kala mondoolopa yaNasaret. Kalunga okwa tseya kutya ye omuntu omwaanawa noonkondo. Osho molwashoka ye a tumu omuyengeli gwe Gabriel okupopya naye. Owa tseya kutya Gabriel okwe ya okulombwela Maria shike? Natu tale.

‘Wu uhala po, omusilwahenda ngoye,’ Gabriel ta ti kuye. ‘Jehova oku li pamwe nangoye.’ Maria ina mona nando onale omuntu nguka. Ye okwa kumwa, oshoka ye ke shi wo shoka ye a hala okutya. Ihe Gabriel ota mweneke okutila kwe mbalambala.

‘Ino kala wa tila, Maria,’ ye ta ti. ‘Jehova oku ku hole noonkondo. Osho molwashoka ye te ke ku ningila sha oshikumithi. Meni lyokathimbo ngoye oto ka mona okanona. Nou na oku ka luka Jesus.’

Gabriel ota tsikile nokuyelitha: ‘Okanona otaka kala okanene, notaka lukwa Omuna gwaKalunga gwOkombandambanda. Jehova ote ke mu ninga omukwaniilwa, ngaashi naanaa David a li. Ihe Jesus ota ka kala omukwaniilwa sigo aluhe, nuukwaniilwa we itau ka hula po nando!’

‘Ongiini tashi vulika?’ Maria ta pula. ‘Ngame inandi hokanwa nokuli. Ngame inandi kala pamwe nomulumentu, ongiini nduno tandi vulu okumona okanona?’

‘Oonkondo dhaKalunga otadhi ku ya,’ Gabriel ta yamukula. ‘Ano okanona otaka ka lukwa Omuna gwaKalunga.’ Opo nduno ota ti kuMaria: ‘Dhimbulukwa oshilyo shuukwanezimo woye Elisabet. Aantu oya ti kutya ye okwa kulupa noonkondo nokumona aanona. Ihe ye meni lyokathimbo ota ka mona okamati. Ngaashi ngoye to vulu okumona, kapu na sha shoka Kalunga itaa vulu okuninga.’

Maria ota ti mbalambala: ‘Ngame omulongelikadhona gwaJehova! Nashi ningilwe ndje ngaashi naanaa wa ti.’ Opo nduno omuyengeli ota yi.

Maria ota yi mbalambala a ka talele po Elisabet. Sho Elisabet tu uvu ewi lyaMaria, okanona mela lyaElisabet otaka nuka kenyanyu. Elisabet oku udhithwa nombepo yaKalunga nota ti kuMaria: ‘Ongoye omulalekwa nuuyamba mokati kaakiintu.’ Maria ota kala puElisabet konyala oomwedhi ndatu nopo nduno ta shuna kegumbo kuNasaret.

Maria oku li pokuhokana nomulumentu gwedhina Josef. Ihe sho Josef tu uvu kutya Maria omusimba, ye ota dhiladhila kutya ye ke na okuhokana naye. Opo nduno omuyengeli gwaKalunga ota ti kuye: ‘Ino kala wa tila okukutha Maria a ninge omukiintu gwoye. Oshoka oye Kalunga ngoka e mu pe okamati.’ Maria naJosef ano otaa hokana notaa tegelele Jesus a valwe. Lukas 1:26-56; Mateus 1:18-25.

OWA tseya kutya okahanona haka oko lye? Eeno, oko Jesus. Ye opo owala a valelwa moshigunda. Oshigunda omo moka hamu kala iimuna. Maria ota langeke Jesus metemba, ehala moka iipalutha yuusino niimuna yilwe hayi tulwa. Ihe omolwashike Maria naJosef ye li mpaka piinamwenyo? Kapu shi ndishi pehala lyokumonena okanona?

Aawe, kapu shi. Ihe yo oye li mpaka molwashoka omupangeli gwaRoma, Omukeesali Augustus, okwa ningi po ompango kutya kehe gumwe e na okushuna koshilando she hoka a valelwa opo edhina lye li vule okunyolelwa membo. Josef okwa valelwa mpaka muBetlehem. Ihe sho ye naMaria ya thiki mpaka, kapwa li nando oompoka pu na ondjugo yokukalwa kuyo. Ano yo oya li ye na okukala pamwe niinamwenyo. Nomesiku tuu ndyoka Maria okwa mono Jesus! Ihe ngaashi ngoye to vulu okumona, ko kake na nando uusama washa.



Ngoye oto vulu mbela okumona aasita mboka taye ya kuJesus? Yo oya li taa tonatele oonzi dhawo uusiku mokuti, nuuyelele tau adhima we ya kundukidha owe ya adhimine. Okwa li omuyengeli! Aasita oya li ya tila noonkondo. Ihe omuyengeli okwa ti: ‘Inamu kala mwa tila! Ngame ondi mu nine onkundana ombwanawa. Kristus Omuwa, okwa valelwa nena ndjika mu-Betlehem. Ye ota ka hupitha oshigwana! Ne otamu ke mu adha a dhiingilwa momalapi nokwa langekwa metemba.’ Ombadhilila opwe ya aayengeli oyendji noya tameke okuhambelela Kalunga. Ano aasita mbaka oya yi mbalambala ya ka konge Jesus, nongashingeyi oye mu mono.

Owa tseya kutya omolwashike Jesus i ili ngawo? Owa tseya kutya oye naanaa lye? Oto dhimbulukwa mbela kutya tse otwe ku hokololela mehokololo lyotango membo ndika kombinga yOmwana gwaKalunga gwotango? Omwana nguka okwa longo pamwe naJehova sho ye a shiti egulu nevi niinima ayihe yilwe. Ano nguka oye Jesus!

Eeno, Jehova okwa kutha omwenyo gwOmwana megulu nokwe gu tula mela lyaMaria. Mbalambala okanona oka tameke taka koko mela lye ngaashi naanaa aanona yalwe haa koko momala gooyina. Ihe okanona haka oka li Omwana gwaKalunga. Lwahugunina Jesus okwa valelwa mpaka moshigunda muBetlehem. Ngoye oto vulu mbela ngashingeyi okuuva ko kutya omolwashike aayengeli ya halele okulombwela aantu ngawo kutya Jesus okwa valwa? Lukas 2:1-20.

NGOYE oto vulu mbela okumona onyothi ndjoka tayi adhima hwiya taku ulikwa kugumwe gwomaalumentu mbaka? Onyothi oya holoka po sho yo ya thigi po Jerusalem. Aalumentu mbaka otaa zi kUuzilo, nohaa konakona oonyothi. Yo oyi itaala kutya onyothi ndjika ompe otayi ya fala komuntu a simana. Sho aalumentu ye ya puJerusalem, yo oya pula: ‘Okanona hoka taka ka ninga omukwaniilwa gwAajuda oke li peni?’ “Aajuda” olyo edhina limwe lyAaisrael. ‘Tse otwa li mUuzilo sho twa mono onyothi yokanona oshikando shotango,’ aalumentu osho ya ti, ‘notwe ya tu ka galikane.’

Sho Herodes, ngoka omukwaniilwa muJerusalem, tu uvu kombinga yaashino, ye okwa li u uvite nayi noonkondo. Ye ka li a hala omukwaniilwa gulwe a kuthe po ehala lye. Ano Herodes okwi ithana aasaaseri aakuluntu nokwa pula: ‘Omukwaniilwa omuuvanekwa ota ka valelwa peni?’ Yo oya yamukula: ‘Ombimbeli otayi ti omuBetlehem.’

Ano Herodes okwi ithana aalumentu yokUuzilo nokwa ti: ‘Ka kongeni okanona okashona. Uuna mwe ka mono, tseyithilii ndje. Ngame onda hala wo oku ke ka galikana.’ Ihe paushili wo wene Herodes okwa hala okanona e ka mone opo e ka dhipage!

Opo nduno onyothi otayi inyenge komeho yaalumentu yu uka kuBetlehem, notayi ka thikama kombanda yehala mpoka okanona ke li. Sho aalumentu taa yi megumbo, otaa mono Maria naJesus omushona. Yo otaa kutha mo omagano notaye ga pe Jesus. Ihe konima Jehova ota londodha aalumentu mondjodhi kaaya shune we kuHerodes. Ano yo otaa shuna kevi lyaandjawo nondjila yilwe.

Sho Herodes tu uvu kutya aalumentu yokUuzilo oya shuna ishewe kegumbo, ye ota geye noonkondo. Ano ye ota gandja elombwelo kutya aamati ayehe kuBetlehem mboka ye li kohi yuukokele woomvula mbali ye na okudhipagwa. Ihe Jehova ota londodha Josef kuyele mondjodhi, Josef nota tembukile muEgipiti nuukwanegumbo we. Konima sho Josef tu uvu kutya Herodes okwa sa, ye ota kutha Maria naJesus ya shune kegumbo kuNasaret. Oko nkoka Jesus a putukile.

Oto dhiladhila mbela kutya olye ngoka a adhimitha onyothi ndjiyaka ompe? Dhimbulukwa, aalumentu oya yi tango kuJerusalem sho yo ya mono onyothi. Satana Ondiaboli okwa li a hala a dhipage Omwana gwaKalunga, nokwa tseya kutya Omukwaniilwa Herodes gwaJerusalem ota ka kambadhala oku mu dhipaga. Ano Satana oye ngoka a li a adhimitha onyothi ndjiyaka. Mateus 2:1-23; Mika 5:1.

TALA kokamati hoka taka popi naalumentu mbaka aakuluntu. Oyo aalongihapu motempeli yaKalunga muJerusalem. Nokamati oJesus. Ye okwa koka ngaaka shi li hwepo. Ye ngashingeyi oku na oomvula 12.

Aalongihapu oya kumwa unene sho Jesus e shi oshindji ngawo kombinga yaKalunga niinima mbyoka ya nyolwa mOmbimbeli. Omolwashike Josef naMaria kaaye li wo mpaka? Oye li peni? Natu tale.

Omvula kehe Josef ohe eta uukwanegumbo we kuJerusalem omolwoshituthi shi ikalekelwa shedhina Opaasa. Olwo olweendo olule okuza kuNasaret to yi kuJerusalem. Kapu na gumwe e na ohauto, nokapu na omashina gokolutenda. Pethimbo mpono kapwa li natango iinima ya tya ngawo. Aantu oyendji ohaye ende kolupadhi, nohashi ya pula konyala omasiku gatatu okuthika kuJerusalem.

Ngashingeyi Josef oku na uukwanegumbo owindji. Ano Jesus oku na aamwayina aamati naakadhona aashona mboka ye na okutonatelwa. Omvula ndjono Josef naMaria oye li molweendo olule pamwe naanona yawo okushuna kegumbo kuNasaret. Yo otaa dhiladhila kutya Jesus oku li maaendi yalwe. Ihe sho ye ende uule wesiku limwe, yo itaa vulu okumona Jesus. Otaye mu kongo mokati kaakwawo nokooyakwawo, ihe ye ke mo muyo! Ano otaa galukile kuJerusalem oku ke mu konga hoka.

Lwahugunina otaya adha Jesus mpaka paalongihapu. Ye ote ya pulakene note ya pula omapulo. Naantu ayehe oya kumwa kombinga yankene Jesus omunandunge. Ihe Maria ota ti: ‘Omumwandje, omolwashike we shi tu ningile? Ngame naho otwi ipula noonkondo kombinga yoye.’

‘Omolwashike mwa kongele ndje?’ Jesus ta yamukula. ‘Kamu shi shi kutya ngame ondi na okukala megumbo lyaTate?’

Eeno, Jesus okwa hala okukala pomahala mpoka ye ta vulu okwiilonga kombinga yaKalunga. Hasho mbela natse tu na okuuva ngawo? MuNasaret kegumbo Jesus oha yi oshiwike kehe komakugongala oku ka galikana. Molwashoka ye oha gandja eitulomo aluhe, ye okwi ilongo iinima oyindji yomOmbimbeli. Natu kaleni ngaashi Jesus nokulandula oshiholelwa she. Lukas 2:41-52; Mateus 13:53-56.

OU WETE onguti ndjoka tayi kulukile komutse gwomulumentu? Omulumentu oJesus. Ye ngashingeyi oku na oomvula 30 lwaampono. Nomulumentu puye oJohannes. Tse otwi ilonga nale sha kombinga ye. Oto dhimbulukwa mbela kutya Maria okwa talelele po oshilyo shuukwanezimo we Elisabet nonokutya okanona mela lyaElisabet oka nukile kenyanyu? Okanona hoka inaaka valwa oka li Johannes. Ihe Johannes naJesus otaa ningi shike ngashingeyi?

Johannes opo a thindile Jesus kohi yomeya mOmulonga gwa-Jordan. Shika osho nkene omuntu ha ninginithwa. Ye ota thindilwa tango kohi yomeya nopo nduno ota andulwa ko. Molwashoka Johannes osho ha ningile aantu, ye okwa lukwa Johannes Omuninginithi. Ihe omolwashike Johannes a ninginitha Jesus?

Johannes okwe shi ningi molwashoka Jesus okwe mu pula e mu ninginithe. Johannes oha ninginitha aantu mboka ya hala yu ulike kutya yo oyu uvite nayi kombinga yiinima mbyoka iiwinayi yo ya ningi. Ihe Jesus okwa ninga ngaa mbela sha oshiwinayi okukala e uvite nayi kusho? Aawe, Jesus ine shi ninga nando, oshoka ye Omwana gwaKalunga a zi megulu. Ye okwa pula Johannes e mu ninginithe molwetompelo lilwe. Natu taleni kutya etompelo ndyoka olya li shike.

Manga Jesus inee ya mpaka kuJohannes, ye okwa li omuhongi gwiipilangi. Omuhongi gwiipilangi omuntu ngoka ha ningi iinima miipilangi ngaashi iitaafula niipundi. Omulumentu gwaMaria Josef okwa li omuhongi gwiipilangi, nokwa longo wo Jesus okukala gumwe. Ihe Jehova ina tuma Omwana kombanda yevi okukala omuhongi gwiipilangi. Ye oku mu nine iilonga yi ikalekelwa, nethimbo olya thikana opo Jesus a tameke oku yi longa. Ano Jesus ota pula Johannes e mu ninginithe okuulika kutya ye ngashingeyi okwe ya okulonga ehalo lyaHe. Kalunga mbela okwe shi hokwa ngaa? Eeno, oshoka sho Jesus ta zi momeya, ewi okuza megulu otali ti: ‘Nguka Omumwandje ngoka ngame nde mu hokwa.’ Otashi monika wo sha fa egulu tali eguluka nonguti ndjika otayi kulukile kombanda yaJesus. Ihe kayi shi onguti yo yene. Otayi monika naanaa ya fa oyo. Paushili wo wene oyo ombepo ondjapuki yaKalunga.

Ngashingeyi Jesus oku na oshindji okudhiladhila, ano ota yi kehala lyi ikalela uule womasiku 40. Hoka Satana ote ya kuye. Satana ota kambadhala iikando itatu a teyithe Jesus oompango dhaKalunga. Ihe Jesus ota tindi.

Konima Jesus ota galuka nota tsakaneke aalumentu yamwe mboka taa ningi aalanduli nenge aalongwa ye yotango. Mokati kawo omu na Andreas, Petrus (i ithanwa wo Simon), Filippus naNatanael (i ithanwa wo Bartolomeus). Jesus naalongwa mbaka aape otaa yi kuGalilea. MuGalilea yo oya kala muKaana, moshilando moka mwa kala Natanael. Hoka Jesus ota yi kohango onene nota longo oshikumithalonga she shotango. Owa tseya kutya oshashike? Ye ota lundululile omeya momaviinu. Mateus 3:13-17; 4:1-11; 13:55; Markus 6:3; Johannes 1:29-51; 2:1-12.

JESUS ota monika mpaka a geya lelalela, hasho mbela? Owa tseya kutya omolwashike a geya ngawo? Osho molwashoka aalumentu mbaka motempeli yaKalunga muJerusalem oyo aaholi yiimaliwa. Yo otaa kambadhala ya mone iimaliwa oyindji maantu mboka taye ya mpaka okugalikana Kalunga.

Ou wete oondumetana noonzi noonguti adhihe ndhoka? Aalumentu otaa landithile iinamwenyo mbika lelalela mpaka potempeli. Owa tseya kutya omolwashike? Osho molwashoka Aaisrael oya pumbwa iinamwenyo nuudhila okuyambela Kalunga.

Ompango yaKalunga oya ti kutya uuna Omwiisrael a yono, ye oku na okweeta eyambo kuKalunga. Nopwa li wo omathimbo galwe uuna Aaisrael ya li ye na okweeta omayambo. Ihe openi Omwiisrael ta vulu okwaadha uudhila niinamwenyo okuyambela Kalunga?

Aaisrael yamwe oya li ye na uudhila niinamwenyo yawo yene. Ano yo oya li taa vulu oku yi yamba. Ihe Aaisrael oyendji kaya li ye na iinamwenyo nenge uudhila. Yalwe noya kala kokule ngaaka naJerusalem yo kaya li taa vulu okweeta yimwe yomiinamwenyo yawo kotempeli. Ano aantu oye ya mpaka nokulanda iinamwenyo nenge uudhila mbyoka yo ya pumbwa. Ihe aalumentu mbaka oya futitha aantu oshindji unene. Yo oya nyokoma aantu. Kakele kaashono yo kaye na okulanditha iinima lelalela mpaka motempeli yaKalunga.

Osho shoka sha geyitha Jesus. Ano ye ota tilehi iitaafula yaalumentu aaniimaliwa, niimaliwa yawo ote yi halakanitha. Ye ota ningi wo ongola yongodhi nota tidha mo iinamwenyo ayihe motempeli. Ye ota lombwele aalandithi yoonguti: ‘Dhi kutheni po mpaka! Hulitheni okuninga egumbo lyaTate ehala lyokwiimonena iimaliwa oyindji.’

Yamwe yomaalanduli yaJesus oye li pamwe naye mpaka potempeli muJerusalem. Yo oya kumwa kwaashoka ye wete Jesus ta ningi. Opo nduno otaa dhimbulukwa ehala mOmbimbeli mpoka tapu tiwa kombinga yOmwana gwaKalunga: ‘Ohole yokuhola egumbo lyaKalunga otayi ka kala ya fa omulilo tagu fike muye.’

Manga Jesus e li mpaka muJerusalem pOpaasa, ye ota longo iikumithalonga oyindji. Konima Jesus ota thigi po Judea nota tameke nolweendo lwe okushuna kuGalilea. Ihe mondjila yokuya hoka ye ota pitile muSamaria. Natu tale kutya oshike sha ningwa po hoka. Johannes 2:13-25; 4:3, 4.

JESUS okwa vululukwa pomuthima muSamaria. Aalongwa ye oya yi koshilando ya ka lande iikulya. Omukiintu ngoka ta popi naJesus, okwe ya okuteka omeya. Ye ota ti kuye: ‘Pe ndje wo omeya ndi nwe.’

Otashi kumitha omukiintu noonkondo. Owa tseya kutya omolwashike? Omolwashoka Jesus Omujuda naye Omusamaria. NAajuda oyendji kaye hole Aasamaria. Nokuli yo ihaa popi nayo! Ihe Jesus oku hole aantu yomaludhi agehe. Ano ye ota ti: ‘Andola ngoye wa li wa tseya ngoka te ku pula omeya, ando ngoye owe mu pula note ku pe omeya omagandjimwenyo.’

‘Tatekulu,’ omukiintu ta ti, ‘omuthima omule, ngoye ku na nokuli eyemele. Openi mpoka to adha omeya omagandjimwenyo?’

‘Ngele ngoye to nu omeya gomomuthima nguka, ngoye oto ka sa natango enota,’ Jesus ta yelitha. ‘Ihe omeya ngoka ngame handi gandja, otaga vulu okukaleka omuntu nomwenyo sigo aluhe.’

‘Tatekulu,’ omukiintu ta ti, ‘pe ndje omeya ngaka! Opo nduno ngame itandi si we nando enota. Noitandi ka pumbwa we okwiila omeya huka.’

Omukiintu ota dhiladhila kutya Jesus ota popi omeya go gene. Ihe ye ota popi kombinga yoshili yaKalunga noyUukwaniilwa we. Oshili ndjika oya fa omeya omagandjimwenyo. Otayi vulu okupa omuntu omwenyo gwaaluhe.

Ngashingeyi Jesus ota ti komukiintu: ‘Inda u ki ithane omulumentu gwoye nou galuke.’

‘Ngame kandi na omulumentu,’ ye ta yamukula.

‘Ngoye owa yamukula mondjila,’ Jesus ta ti. ‘Ihe ngoye owa li u na aalumentu yatano, nomulumentu ngoka u li pamwe naye ngashingeyi, ke shi gwoye.’

Omukiintu okwa kumwa, oshoka iinima ayihe mbika oyoshili. Ongiini Jesus a tseya iinima mbika? Eeno, osho molwashoka Jesus oye Omuuvanekwa Ngoka a tumwa kuKalunga, Kalunga note mu pe eyelithilo ndika. Pethimbo opo tuu mpoka aalongwa yaJesus otaa galuka, noya kumwa sho ye ta popi nomukiintu Omusamaria.

Tse otatu ilongo mo shike muka? Otashi ulike kutya Jesus oha ningile aantu yomomihoko adhihe nawa. Natse wo otu na okukala ngawo. Katu na okudhiladhila kutya aantu yalwe aawinayi molwashoka owala yo yomuhoko gwontumba. Jesus okwa hala aantu ayehe ya tseye oshili ndjoka tayi fala sigo okomwenyo gwaaluhe. Noshi na okukala wo ehalo lyetu okukwathela aantu yi ilonge oshili. Johannes 4:5-43; 17:3.

TALA kuJesus ngoka a kuutumba mpaka. Ye ota longo aantu ayehe mbaka kondundu muGalilea. Mboka ya kuutumba popepi naye oyo aalongwa ye. Ye okwa hogolola 12 yomuyo ya kale aayapostoli ye. Aayapostoli oyo aalongwa yaJesus yi ikalekelwa. Owa tseya omadhina gawo?

Opu na Simon Petrus nomumwayina Andreas. Opo nduno opu na Jakob naJohannes, mboka wo aamwayinathana. Opu na wo omuyapostoli gwedhina Jakob, nagumwe natango gwedhina Simon. Aayapostoli yaali oye na edhina Judas. Gumwe oJudas Iskariot, na Judas gulwe oti ithanwa wo Taddeus. Opo nduno opu na Filippus naNatanael (ngoka i ithanwa wo Bartolomeus), naMateus naTomas.

Sho ye a shuna okuza muSamaria, Jesus okwa tameke tu uvitha oshikando shotango: ‘Uukwaniilwa womegulu ou li popepi.’ Owa tseya kutya uukwaniilwa mboka oshike? Owo epangelo lyaKalunga lyolela. Jesus oye omukwaniilwa gwalyo. Ye ota ka pangela okuza megulu note ke eta ombili kombanda yevi. Uukwaniilwa waKalunga otau ka lundululila evi alihe moparadisa ombwanawa.

Jesus ota longo aantu mpaka kombinga yUukwaniilwa. ‘Ne omu na okugalikana ngeyi,’ ye ta yelitha. ‘Tate yetu megulu, edhina lyoye nali yapulwe. Uukwaniilwa woye nau ye. Ehalo lyoye nali gwanithwe kombanda yevi, ngaashika naanaa megulu.’ Aantu oyendji ohaye li ithana ‘Egalikano lyOmuwa Gwetu.’ Yamwe otaye li ithana ‘Tate Yetu Ngu U Li mEgulu.’ Ngoye oto vulu mbela okuhokolola egalikano alihe? Jesus ota longo wo aantu nkene ye na okukalathana. ‘Ningila yalwe shoka ngoye wa hala ye shi ku ningile,’ ye ta ti. Ndishi ngoye ou shi hole ngele yalwe taye ku ningile uuwanawa? Ano Jesus ota ti kutya tse otu na okuningila yalwe uuwanawa. Otashi ka kala oshikumithi meviparadisa uuna ayehe taye ke shi ninga, hasho mbela? Mateus ontopolwa 5 sigo 7; 10:1-4.

OMUKADHONA ngoka ngoye u wete mpaka oku na oomvula 12. Jesus ota kwata oshikaha she, yina nahe noya thikama mpeyaka popepi. Owa tseya kutya omolwashike yo ye uvite elago ngawo? Natu tale.

He yomukadhona omulumentu a simana gwedhina Jairus. Esiku limwe omwanakadhona ote ehama nota tulwa mombete. Ihe ita talalelwa. Ye ote ehama nokweehamenena owala. Jairus nomukiintu gwe oya nika uuthigwa noonkondo, oshoka otashi monika sha fa ongo omukadhona gwawo ta si. Ye oye omukadhona epona gwawo. Ano Jairus ota ka konga Jesus. Ye oku uva kombinga yiikumithalonga yaJesus.

Sho Jairus ta mono Jesus, opu na ongundu onene yaantu ye mu kundukidha. Ihe Jairus ota thininike mongundu yaantu nota gwile poompadhi dhaJesus. ‘Omumwandje ota alukililwa,’ ye ta ti. ‘Alikana ila u mu aludhe,’ ye te mu galikana. Jesus ota ti kutya ye ote ke ya.

Manga yo taye ende, ongundu yaantu otayi undula yi hedhe popepi naye. Ombadhilila Jesus ota thikama. ‘Olye a gumu ndje?’ ye ta pula. Jesus oku uvite nkene oonkondo tadhi zi muye, ano ye oku shi shi kutya opu na gumwe e mu gumu. Ihe olye? Oye omukiintu ngoka a li a ala noonkondo uule woomvula 12. Ye okwa gumu koonguwo dhaJesus nokwa aluka!

Shika otashi uvitha Jairus nawa, oshoka ye ota vulu okumona nkene oshipu kuJesus okwaaludha gumwe. Ihe otapu ya nduno ontumwa. ‘Ino vulitha we Jesus,’ ye ta ti kuJairus. ‘Omumwoye okwa sa.’ Jesus ote shi uvu nota ti kuJairus: ‘Ino nika uuthigwa, ye ota ka aluka.’

Sho yo taa thiki pegumbo lyaJairus, aantu otaa lili noluhodhi olunene. Ihe Jesus ota ti: ‘Inamu lila. Omunona ina sa. Ye okwa kotha owala.’ Ihe yo otaa yolo notaa sheke Jesus, oshoka yo oye shi shi kutya ye okwa sa.

Opo nduno Jesus ota fala he nayina yomukadhona nayatatu yomaayapostoli ye kondunda hoka kwa lala omunona. Ye ota kutha oshikaha she nota ti: ‘Thikama po!’ Nota ningi omwenyo, ngaashi naanaa ngoye u wete mpaka. Nota thikama po note ende! Osho molwashoka yina nahe ya nyanyukwa ngawo.

Haye omuntu gwotango ngoka Jesus a yumudha kuusi. Gwo-tango ngoka Ombimbeli tayi hokolola oye omumati gwomuselekadhi a kala moshilando shaNain. Konima Jesus ota yumudha wo kuusi Lasarus, omumwayina gwaMaria naMarta. Uuna Jesus ta pangele oye omukwaniilwa gwaKalunga, ye ota ka yumudha aantu oonakusa oyendji kaaye shi okuyalulwa. Mbela tse itatu vulu okukala twa nyanyukwa kwaashino? Lukas 8:40-56; 7:11-17; Johannes 11:17-44.

SHA oshitilithi osha ningwa po. Johannes Omuninginithi opo owala a dhipagwa. Herodias, omukiintu gwomukwaniilwa, kakwa li e mu hole. Nokwa ningitha omukwaniilwa a tetithe ko omutse gwaJohannes.

Sho Jesus te shi uvu, ye ota yemata noonkondo. Ye ota yi oye awike kehala lyi ikalela. Ihe aantu otaye mu landula. Sho Jesus ta mono oongundu dhaantu, ye ote dhi uvitile ohenda. Ano ye ota popi nayo kombinga yUukwaniilwa waKalunga nota aludha aavu.

Uusiku owo tuu mboka aalongwa ye otaye ya kuye notaa ti: ‘Okwa toka nale, nolyo ehala lyi ikalela. Tuma aantu ya ye opo yo ya vule oku ki ilandela iikulya muulando wopopepi mpoka.’

‘Yo inashi pumbiwa ya ye,’ Jesus ta yamukula. ‘Ya peni sha shokulya.’ Jesus ota pungulukile kuFilippus nota pula: ‘Openi tatu vulu okulanda iikulya tayi gwana okupalutha aantu ayehe mbaka?’

‘Otashi ka pula iimaliwa oyindji noonkondo okulanda iikulya oyindji ya gwanena opo kehe gumwe a vule okumona okashona kowala,’ Filippus ta yamukula. Andreas ota ti: ‘Omumati nguka, ngoka a humbata iikulya yetu, oku na iikwiila itano noohi mbali. Ihe itayi gwana nando aantu ayehe mbaka.’

‘Lombwela aantu ya kuutumbe pomwiidhi,’ Jesus ta ti. Opo nduno ye ota pandula Kalunga molwiikulya note yi pambula muupambu. Konima aalongwa otaa topolele aantu iikwiila noohi. Opu na aalumentu 5 000, nosho wo aakiintu naanona omayuvi. Yo ayehe otaa li sigo yo ya kuta. Nuuna aalongwa taa toola iikulya mbyoka ya hupu po, otayi udha oontungwa 12!

Ngashingeyi Jesus ota londeke aalongwa ye mowato ya ye handiyaka yEfuta lyaGalilea. Uusiku oshikungulu oshinene otashi ya, nomakuthikuthi otaga undulile owato hwiya naahwiyaka. Aalongwa oya tila noonkondo. Opo nduno mokati kuusiku otaa mono nkene gumwe te ende kombanda yomeya te ya kuyo. Yo otayi igidha kuumbanda, oshoka yo kaye shi wo shoka yo ye wete.

‘Inamu kala mwa tila,’ Jesus ta ti. ‘Ongame!’ Yo natango itaa vulu oku shi zimina. Ano Petrus ota ti: ‘Omuwa, ngele ongoye shili, lombwela ndje nduno ndi ye kungoye tandi ende kombanda yomeya.’ Jesus ota yamukula: ‘Ila!’ Petrus nota londoloka mo note ende kombanda yomeya! Opo nduno ye ota tila nota tameke okuningina, ihe Jesus ote mu hupitha.

Konima Jesus ota palutha ishewe aantu omayuvi. Oshikando shika ye ote shi ningi niikwiila iheyali noohi dhimwe oonshona. Notayi gwanene natango ayehe. Nkene Jesus ha sile aantu ayehe oshimpwiyu kashi shi mbela oshikumithi? Uuna ye ta pangele oye omukwaniilwa gwaKalunga, tse katu na nando okwiipula kombinga yasha! Mateus 14:1-32; 15:29-38; Johannes 6:1-21.

TALA kuJesus mpaka ta papatele nomaako ge okamati. Ngoye oto vulu okumona kutya Jesus oku na ko nasha naanona aashona. Aalumentu mpaka puye oyo aayapostoli ye. Jesus ota ti shike kuyo? Natu tale.

Jesus naayapostoli ye opo ya galuka molweendo olule. Mondjila aayapostoli ye oya patathana. Ano konima yolweendo Jesus ote ya pula: ‘Okombinga yashike mwa li tamu patathana mondjila?’ Ihe Jesus oku shi shi kutya okombinga yashike ya li taa patathana. Ihe ye ota pula epulo okutala ngele aayapostoli otaye shi mu hokololele.

Aayapostoli itaa yamukula, oshoka mondjila oya patathana kombinga yaangoka a simana e vule yakwawo. Aayapostoli yamwe oya hala okukala ya simana ye vule yalwe. Ongiini Jesus te ke ya lombwela kutya kashi li mondjila okukala wa hala u kale wa simana u vule yakweni?

Ye oti ithana okamati note ka thikameke komeho gawo. Opo nduno ota ti kaalongwa ye: ‘Ngame onda hala ne mu tseye kutya ngele ne itamu lundulula nokukala mwa fa okanona nkaka, ne itamu ka ya mo nando muukwaniilwa waKalunga. Omuntu a simana e vule yakwawo muukwaniilwa oye ngoka ta kala ngaashi okanona haka.’ Owa tseya kutya omolwashike Jesus e shi tile?

Ano aanona aashona ihayu uvu nayi ngele yo inaa simana ye vule yalwe. Ano aayapostoli oye na okwiilonga mombinga ndjika ya kale ngaashi aanona noyaa patathane kombinga yaangoka a simana e vule yakwawo.

Opu na wo omathimbo galwe uuna Jesus tu ulike nkene ye e na ko nasha noonkondo naanona. Konima yoomwedhi dhontumba aantu yamwe otaye eta aanona yawo kuJesus. Aayapostoli otaa kambadhala ye ya keelele. Ihe Jesus ota ti kaayapostoli ye: ‘Etheni aanona ye ye kungame, ne kamu na oku ya keelela ko, oshoka uukwaniilwa waKalunga owaamboka ye ya fa.’ Opo nduno Jesus ota papatele aanona nomaako ge note ya yambeke. Oshiwanawa ndishi okutseya kutya Jesus oku hole aanona aashona? Mateus 18:1-4; 19:13-15; Markus 9:33-37; 10:13-16.

ESIKU limwe Jesus ota lombwele omulumentu kutya ye oku na okuhola omukwawo. Omulumentu ota pula Jesus: ‘Omukwetu olye?’ Ano Jesus oku shi shoka omulumentu nguka ta dhiladhila. Omulumentu ota dhiladhila kutya omukwawo aantu owala mboka yomuhoko gwe noyelongelokalunga lye. Ano natu tale shoka Jesus ta ti kuye.

Oolumwe Jesus ota longo yalwe moku ya hokololela ehokololo. Osho shoka ye ta ningi ngashingeyi. Ye ota hokolola ehokololo kombinga yOmujuda nOmusamaria. Tse otwi ilonga nale kutya Aajuda oyendji kaye hole Aasamaria. Ehokololo lyaJesus olyo ndika:

Esiku limwe Omujuda okwe ende nondjila yokondundu ta yi kuJeriko. Ihe aayugi oye mu ponokele. Yo oye mu kutha iimaliwa ye noye mu dhenge sigo konyala a se.

Konima omusaaseri Omujuda okwe ende po. Ye okwa mono omulumentu ngoka omweehamekwa. Mbela ngoye oto dhiladhila kutya ye okwa ningi po shike? Ye okwa yi owala nombinga yilwe yondjila nota tsikile nolweendo lwe. Opo tuu mpoka omuntu gulwe i ishi uukalunga okwa piti po. Ye okwa li Omulevi. Ye mbela okwe mu kwatha ngaa? Aawe, ye naye wo ina kwatha omulumentu omweehamekwa. Ngoye oto vulu okumona omusaaseri nOmulevi mpeyaka kokule taye ende nondjila.

Ihe olye nguka pomulumentu omweehamekwa? Oye Omusamaria. Nota kwatha Omujuda. Ye ota tula omiti piilalo ye. Konima ye ota fala Omujuda kehala hoka ye ta vulu okuvululukwa nokwaaluka.

Kehulilo lyehokololo lye Jesus ota pula omulumentu ngoka a pulile epulo: ‘Olye gwomwaambaka yatatu ngoye to dhiladhila a katuka ngaashi oye omukwawo gwomweehamekwa? Omusaaseri, Omulevi nenge Omusamaria?’

Omulumentu ota yamukula: ‘Omulumentu Omusamaria. Ye okwa li nawa nomulumentu ngoka e ehamekwa.’

Jesus ota ti: ‘Ngoye ou li mondjila. Ano inda u ka ningile yalwe ngaashi naanaa omulumentu ngoka a ningi.’

Ngoye ku hole mbela omukalo ngoka Jesus a longo nagwo yalwe? Tse otatu vulu okwiilonga iinima oyindji ya simana ngele tse otatu pulakene shoka Jesus ta ti mOmbimbeli, hasho mbela? Lukas 10:25-37.

OMANGA Jesus te ende moshilongo, ye ota aludha aavu. Onkundana yiikumithalonga mbika oyi ihanene momikunda nomiilando ayihe yomomudhingoloko. Ano aantu otaye eta iitiningili naaposi noombolo kuye, nosho wo yalwe oyendji mboka taya alukwa. Jesus nota aludha ayehe.

Oomvula odhindji dhi vulithe pundatu odha piti po okuza sho Johannes a ninginitha Jesus. Jesus nota ti kaayapostoli ye kutya meni lyokathimbo ye ota ka ya kuJerusalem, hoka ye ta ka dhipagwa, nopo nduno ota ka yumuka kuusi. Pethimbo opo tuu mpoka Jesus ota tsikile okwaaludha aavu.

Esiku limwe Jesus ota longo mEsabati. Esabati olyo esiku lyevululuko lyAajuda. Omukiintu ngoka ngoye u wete mpaka, okwa li a ala noonkondo. Ye okwe ende uule woomvula 18 a andalala, noka li ta vulu okuthikama u ukilila. Jesus ota tenteke oshikaha she kuye, nota tameke okweenda u ukilila. Ye okwa aluka!

Shika otashi geyitha aawiliki yomalongelokalunga. ‘Opu na omasiku gahamano ngoka tse tu na okulonga,’ gumwe gwomuyo ti igidha mongundu yaantu. ‘Ngoka ogo omasiku gokuya mu aludhwe, hamEsabati!’

Ihe Jesus ota yamukula: ‘One aalumentu aawinayi. Kehe gumwe gwomune oha mangulula mo okasino ke note ka fala komeya ka ka nwe mEsabati. Omukiintu nguka, ngoka a li a ala uule woomvula 18, oye ke na nduno okwaaludhwa mEsabati?’ Eyamukulo lyaJesus otali sitha ohoni aalumentu mbano aawinayi.

Konima Jesus naayapostoli ye otaa yi molweendo lwokuya kuJerusalem. Sho taye ya owala pondje yoshilando shaJeriko, aakwanaluhepo yaali aaposi otayu uvu kutya Jesus ota piti po. Ano yo otayi igidha: ‘Jesus, tu kwatha!’

Jesus oti ithana aalumentu aaposi ye ye kuye nota pula: ‘Omwa hala ndi mu ningile shike?’ Yo otaa ti: ‘Omuwa, tonatitha omeho getu.’ Jesus ota gumu omeho gawo, nombala yo otaa vulu okumona ko! Owa tseya mbela kutya omolwashike Jesus ta longo iikumithalonga ayihe mbino? Omolwashoka ye oku hole aantu nokwa hala yo ye mu itaale. Ano tse otatu vulu okukala nuushili kutya uuna ye ta pangele oye Omukwaniilwa itapu ka kala we gumwe kombanda yevi ta alukwa. Mateus 15:30, 31; Lukas 13:10-17; Mateus 20:29-34.

KONIMA yokathimbo sho Jesus a aludha aakwanaluhepo yaali aaposi, ye ote ya pomukunda gu li popepi naJerusalem. Ye ota ti kuyaali yomaalongwa ye: ‘Indeni komukunda notamu ka mona ontana yokasino. Ka mangululeni mo nomu ke ete huka.’

Sho yo ye eta okasino kuye, Jesus ota londo kuko. Opo nduno ota yi kuJerusalem okakako okafupi okuza mpoka. Sho ye te ya popepi noshilando, otaku zi ongundu onene yaantu taye mu tsakaneke. Oyendji otaa hula mo oonguwo dhawo notaye dhi yala mondjila. Yalwe otaa tete iitayi yomilunga. Yo otaye yi yala wo mondjila notaa igidha: ‘Kalunga na laleke nuuyamba omukwaniilwa ngoka te ya medhina lyaJehova!’

Nalenale muIsrael aakwaniilwa aape oya londo kontana yokasino okuya muJerusalem okwiiholola yo yene kaantu. Osho shoka Jesus ta ningi. Naantu mbaka otaa ulike kutya yo oya hala Jesus oye a kale omukwaniilwa gwawo. Ihe haantu ayehe ye mu hala. Otatu vulu oku shi mona mwaashoka sha ningilwa Jesus sho a yi kotempeli.

Potempeli Jesus okwa aludha aantu mboka aaposi niitiningili. Sho aanona aashona taye shi mono, yo otaa hambelele Jesus. Ihe shika otashi geyitha aasaaseri, oyo notaa ti kuJesus: ‘Ou uvite ko ngaa shoka aanona taa ti?’

‘Eeno, ondu uvite ko,’ Jesus ta yamukula. ‘Inamu lesha nani mOmbimbeli mpoka tayi ti: “Omomakana gaanona aashona Kalunga ota ka longekidhila mo ehambelelo?” ’ Ano aanona otaa tsikile nokuhambelela omukwaniilwa gwaKalunga.

Tse otwa hala okukala ngaashi aanona mboka, hasho mbela? Aantu yalwe otaa ka kambadhala oku tu indika twaa popye kombinga yUukwaniilwa waKalunga. Ihe tse otatu ka tsikila okuhokololela yalwe iinima iikumithi mbyoka Jesus ta ka longela aantu.

Sho Jesus a li kombanda yevi, kalya li ethimbo lye okutameka ta pangele oye omukwaniilwa. Uunake ano ethimbo ndino tali ka thikana? Aalongwa yaJesus oya hala oku shi tseya. Tse oshikando tashi landula otatu ka lesha kombinga yasho. Mateus 21:1-17; Johannes 12:12-16.

NGUKA oJesus kOndundu yOomono. Aalumentu yane puye oyo aayapostoli ye. Oyo aamwayinathana Andreas naPetrus, nosho wo aamwayinathana Jakob naJohannes. Shoka u wete hwiya kokule osho otempeli yaKalunga muJerusalem. Ngashingeyi omasiku gaali okuza sho Jesus a li a londa ontana yokasino okuya muJerusalem. Olyo Etiyali. Jesus okwa li nale esiku tuu ndyoka motempeli. Moka aasaaseri otaa kambadhala okukwata Jesus ye mu dhipage. Ihe yo oya li ya tila oku shi ninga, oshoka aantu oye hole Jesus.

‘Omayoka ne noluvalo lwomayoka!’ Jesus osho i ithana aawiliki yomalongelokalunga. Opo nduno Jesus okwa ti kutya Kalunga ote ke ya geyela molwiinima ayihe iiwinayi mbyoka yo ya ningi. Konima Jesus okwa londo kOndundu yOomono, nopo nduno aayapostoli mbaka yane otaa tameke oku mu pula omapulo. Owa tseya mbela kutya yo otaa pula Jesus shike?

Aayapostoli otaye mu pula kombinga yonakuyiwa. Yo oye shi shi kutya Jesus ota ka hulitha po uuwinayi auhe kombanda yevi. Ihe yo oya hala ya tseye kutya uunake tashi ka ningwa. Uunake Jesus te ke ya ishewe okupangela oye Omukwaniilwa?

Jesus oku shi shi kutya aalanduli ye kombanda yevi itaa ka vula oku mu mona uuna ye ta galuka ishewe. Osho molwashoka ye ota ka kala megulu nayo itaa ka vula oku mu mona mwiyaka. Ano Jesus ota hokololele aayapostoli ye iinima yimwe mbyoka tayi ka ningwa po kombanda yevi uuna ye ta pangele oye Omukwaniilwa megulu. Mbela yimwe yomiinima mbika iishike?

Jesus ota ti kutya otapu ka kala iita iinene, aantu oyendji otaa ka kala taya alukwa nokuhepekwa kondjala, iilonga yomuyonena otayi ki indjipala, notaku ka kala omakakamo gevi omanene. Jesus ota ti wo kutya onkundana ombwanawa yUukwaniilwa waKalunga otayi ku uvithwa kombanda yevi. Mbela tse otwa mona ngaa iinima mbika tayi ningwa methimbo lyetu? Eeno! Nomolwashoka tse otatu vulu okukala nuushili kutya Jesus ota pangele ngashingeyi megulu. Konima yokathimbo ota ka hulitha po uuwinayi auhe kombanda yevi. Mateus 21:46; 23:1-39; 24:1-14, faathanitha Ombimbeli yOshikwanyama; Markus 13:3-10.

NGASHINGEYI owo uusiku wEtine, konima yomasiku gaali. Jesus naayapostoli ye 12 oye ya koshinyanga shopombanda shika oshinene okulya uulalelo wOpaasa. Omulumentu ngoka ngoye u wete ta piti mo, oye Judas Iskariot. Ye ota yi a ka lombwele aasaaseri nkene yo taa vulu okukwata Jesus.

Esiku owala lya tetekele, Judas okwa yi kuyo nokwa pula: ‘Otamu ka pa ndje shike ngele ngame nde mu kwatha okukwata Jesus?’ Yo oya ti: ‘Iisiliveli omilongo ndatu.’ Ngashingeyi Judas ota yi a ka tsakaneke aalumentu mbaka opo ye a vule oku ya fala kuJesus. Kashi shi oshitilithi mbela?

Uulalelo wOpaasa owa pwa. Ihe Jesus ota tameke ngashingeyi nuulalelo wulwe wi ikalekelwa. Ye ota gandja oshikwiila kaayapostoli ye nota ti: ‘Shi lyeni, oshoka otashi ti olutu lwandje ndoka tamu ke lu gandjelwa.’ Opo nduno ota gandja oshitenga shomaviinu kuyo nota ti: ‘Ga nweni, oshoka otaga ti ombinzi yandje, ndjoka tamu ke yi tilwahililwa.’ Ombimbeli otayi shi luku ‘uulalelo wOmuwa.’

Aaisrael oya li Opaasa oku ya dhimbulukitha nkene omuyengeli gwaKalunga a pitilile po omagumbo gawo muEgipiti nokwa dhipaga aatango momagumbo gAaegipiti. Ihe ngashingeyi Jesus okwa hala aalanduli ye ye mu dhimbulukwe, nosho wo nkene ye e ya gandjele omwenyo gwe. Nosho molwashoka ye te ya lombwele ya lye uulalelo mbuno wi ikalekelwa omvula kehe.

Konima sho ya li Uulalelo wOmuwa, Jesus ota lombwele aayapostoli ye ya kale omapenda noya kale neitaalo lya kola. Opo nduno yo otayi imbile Kalunga eimbilo notaa yi. Ngashingeyi okwa toka noonkondo, tashi vulika konima yomokati kuusiku. Natu tale kutya openi yo taa yi. Mateus 26:14-30; Lukas 22:1-39; Johannes ontopolwa 13 sigo 17; 1 Aakorinto 11:20.

SHO Jesus a thigi po oshinyanga shopombanda, ye naayapostoli ye otaa yi koshikunino shaGetsemane. Yo oye ya olundji mpaka. Jesus ote ya lombwele ngashingeyi ya kale ya tonata nokugalikana. Opo nduno ota humu ko okakako nota petama noshipala she sha tsa pevi a galikane.

Konima Jesus ota galukile mpoka aayapostoli ye ye li. Ngoye oto dhiladhila mbela kutya yo otaa ningi shike? Yo oya kotha! Iikando itatu Jesus te ya lombwele kutya yo oye na okukala ya tonata, ihe oshikando kehe uuna ye ta galuka, ye ota adha ya kotha. ‘Ne otamu vulu okukotha ngiini pethimbo lya tya ngeyi?’ Jesus ta ti sho ye a galuka oshikando shahugunina. ‘Otundi oya thikana opo ngame ndi gandjwe miikaha yaatondi yandje.’

Pethimbo opo tuu mpoka ekudhilo lyongundu onene yaantu otali vulu okuuvika. Tala! Aalumentu otaye ya nomagongamwele noniiti! Noya humbata oonyeka dhokuminikila. Sho yo taye ya popepi, gumwe ote ende ta zi mongundu yaantu u ukilila sigo opuJesus. Ye ote mu thipi komilungu, ngaashi to vulu okumona mpaka. Omulumentu oye Judas Iskariot! Omolwashike ye ta thipi Jesus komilungu?

Jesus ota pula: ‘Judas, oto gwaaleke ndje nethipo lyokomilungu?’ Eeno, ethipo lyokomilungu olyo endhindhiliko. Otali ti kaalumentu mboka ye li puJudas kutya oye Jesus, omulumentu ngoka taa kongo. Ano aatondi yaJesus otaye mu kwata. Ihe Petrus ite ke etha opo yo ya kuthe po owala Jesus ngeyaka. Ye ota pweya mo egongamwele ndyoka ye etelela nota dhenge omulumentu ngoka e li popepi naye. Egongamwele otali ponyo omutse gwomulumentu notali tete ko okutsi kwe kwokolulyo. Ihe Jesus ota gumu okutsi kwomulumentu note ku aludha.

Jesus ota ti kuPetrus: ‘Shunitha mo egongamwele lyoye. Oto dhiladhila mbela kutya ngame itandi vulu okupula Tate aayengeli omayuvi ya hupithe ndje?’ Eeno, ye ota vulu! Ihe Jesus ita pula Kalunga a tume aayengeli yasha, oshoka ye oku shi shi kutya ethimbo olya thikana kaatondi ye ye mu kwate. Ye ote etha ye mu kuthe po. Natu tale ngashingeyi shoka tashi ningilwa Jesus. Mateus 26:36-56; Lukas 22:39-53; Johannes 18:1-12.

TALA koshinima oshitilithi shoka tashi ningwa mpaka! Jesus ota dhipagwa. Yo oye mu alele koshiti. Oomboha otadhi dhengelwa miikaha ye nomoompadhi dhe. Omolwashike gumwe ta kala a hala oku shi ningila Jesus?

Osho molwashoka aantu yamwe oye tonde Jesus. Owa tseya mbela kutya oyo oolye? Gumwe gwomuyo oye omuyengeli omwiinayi Satana Ondiaboli. Oye ngoka a ningitha Adam naEva ya kale inaaya vulika kuJehova. Satana noye ngoka a ningitha aatondi yaJesus ya longe iilonga yomuyonena mbino iitilithi.

Nokuli manga Jesus inaa alelwa koshiti huka, aatondi ye oye mu ningi onyanya. Oto dhimbulukwa mbela nkene yo ya yi koshikunino shaGetsemane noye mu kutha po? Aatondi mboka oya li oolye? Eeno, oya li aakwatelikomeho yomalongelokalunga. Natu tale ano shoka tashi ka ningwa po konima.

Sho Jesus a kwatwa kaakwatelikomeho yomalongelokalunga, aayapostoli ye oya fadhuka po. Yo otaa thigi po Jesus oye awike paatondi ye, oshoka yo oya tila. Ihe aayapostoli Petrus naJohannes itaa yi kokule. Yo otaa landula ko ye li konima kokule ya tale shoka tashi ningilwa Jesus.

Aasaaseri otaa fala Jesus komulumentu a kulupa Annas, ngoka a li nale omusaaseri omukuluntu. Ongundu yaantu itayi kala olule mpaka. Konima yo otaa fala Jesus kegumbo lyaKaifas, ngoka oye ngashingeyi omusaaseri omukuluntu. Aakwatelikomeho yomalongelokalunga oyendji oya gongala pegumbo lye.

Mpaka pegumbo lyaKaifas otaa hokololitha Jesus. Aantu otaye etwa mo ya popye iifundja kombinga yaJesus. Aakwatelikomeho yomalongelokalunga ayehe otaa ti: ‘Jesus oku na okudhipagwa.’ Opo nduno otaye mu hiyile omayeye moshipala notaye mu dhenge noongonyo.

Manga tashi ningwa, Petrus oku li pondje kehale. Owo uusiku wuutalala nomolwashoka aantu otaa tema omulilo. Manga yo taa huhulukwa ya kundukidha omulilo, okakadhona okakalele otaka tala kuPetrus notaka ti: ‘Omulumentu nguka okwa li wo pamwe naJesus.’

‘Aawe, ngame kanda li pamwe naye!’ Petrus ta yamukula.

Iikando itatu aantu taa ti kuPetrus kutya ye okwa li pamwe naJesus. Ihe oshikando kehe Petrus ote shi idhimbike. Sho Petrus e shi popi oshikando oshititatu, Jesus ota punguluka nota tala kuye. Petrus oku uvite nayi molwashoka ye a popi iifundja mbika, nota zi po e ta lili.

Ongula yEtitano sho etango tali piti, aasaaseri otaa fala Jesus kehala lyawo enene lyokugongalela, oshinyanga shaSanhedrin. Mpaka yo otaa kundathana shoka yo taye ke mu ningila. Yo otaye mu fala kuPontius Pilatus, omupangeli gwaJudea.

‘Ye omulumentu omwiinayi,’ aasaaseri taa lombwele Pilatus. ‘Ye oku na okusa.’ Konima yokupula Jesus omapulo, Pilatus ota ti: ‘Ngame itandi dhiladhila kutya ye okwa ninga sha sha puka.’ Opo nduno Pilatus ota tumine Jesus kuHerodes Antipas. Herodes oye omupangeli gwaGalilea, ihe ye okwa kala muJerusalem. Herodes naye wo ita vulu okumona epuko muJesus, onkene ote mu shunitha kuPilatus.

Pilatus okwa hala a mangulule Jesus. Ihe aatondi yaJesus otaa hogolola kutya onkwatwa yilwe oyo yi mangululwe pehala lye. Omulumentu nguka oye omuyugi Barabbas. Ngashingeyi konyala osho omulongo nambali gwomutenya sho Pilatus ta pititha mo Jesus. Ye ota ti kaantu: ‘Taleni! Omukwaniilwa gweni!’ Ihe aasaaseri aakuluntu otayi igidha: ‘Mu kutha po! Mu dhipaga! Mu dhipaga!’ Ano Pilatus ota mangulula mo Barabbas, notaa kutha po Jesus ye ke mu dhipage.

Kuyele mEtitano omutenya Jesus ota alelwa koshiti. Ngoye ito vulu oku ya mona mefano, ihe kombinga kehe yaJesus oku na omukolokoshi ngoka naye wo a alelwa koshiti. Mbala manga Jesus inaa sa, gumwe gwomaakolokoshi ota ti: ‘Dhimbulukwa ndje ngele wa thiki muukwaniilwa woye.’ Na Jesus ota yamukula: ‘Otandi ku uvanekele kutya ngoye oto ka kala pamwe nangame mOparadisa.’

Kali shi mbela euvaneko ekumithi? Owa tseya mbela kutya oparadisa yini po Jesus ta popi? Oparadisa ndjoka Kalunga a shitile petameko oya li peni? Eeno, okombanda yevi. Nuuna Jesus ta pangele megulu oye omukwaniilwa, ye ota ka yumudha omulumentu nguka a nyanyukilwe Oparadisa ompe kombanda yevi. Tse otatu vulu okukala twa nyanyukwa kwaashino, hasho mbela? Mateus 26:57-75; 27:1-50; Lukas 22:54-71; 23:1-49; Johannes 18:12-40; 19:1-30.
